shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat package-lock.json | head -30

cat package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; find src; cat src/*; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui node_modules | grep -i -E "router|gravity|^react" ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "@gravity-ui/navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30; npm ls 2>&1 | head -20
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation dist-tags peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -30

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname react-router-dom@6 2>&1 | tail -8; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader FooterItem MenuItem; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme Text Card Switch SegmentedRadioGroup

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader FooterItem MenuItem; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme Text Card Switch; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls build/docs/components build/docs/hooks; grep -n -i -A40 "required setup\|## Usage\|## Install" README.md | head -90
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components && ls AsideHeader; sed -n 1,200p AsideHeader.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -i "footer\|logo" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -40; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; grep -rn "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts theme/ThemeContext.d.ts theme/useTheme.d.ts; sed -n 250,310p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n 20,60p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Logo.md; sed -n 1,80p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Footer.md | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && find build -name "FooterItem.d.ts" -o -name "types.d.ts" -path "*AsideHeader*" | head; grep -rn "ThemeProvider\|data-theme\|setTheme" /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components && cat AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; grep -n "logo\|renderContent\|renderFooter\|menuItems\|current\|onItemClick\|href\|compact\|hideCollapse" AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "interface AsideHeaderItem\|interface MenuItem" -A30 types.d.ts ../ 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls icons/ | head -3; for i in House Gear Moon Sun CircleInfo LayoutHeader ChartAreaStackedNormalized Person; do ls icons/svgs/*.svg 2>/dev/null | grep -i -x ".*/$(echo $i | sed 's/\([a-z]\)\([A-Z]\)/\1-\2/g' | tr A-Z a-z).svg" ; done; grep -c "" icons/package.json; grep -n "export declare const \(House\|Gear\|Moon\|Sun\|CircleInfo\|Cubes3\|Persons\|Layers\)\b" icons/*.d.ts icons/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; sed -n 1,45p navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "LogoProps" -A25 navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "RenderContentType" -B2 -A8 navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -30; sed -n 58,70p navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
